content.text: /ext:medcp How many patients carry a diagnosis of type 2 diabetes?

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id = 'Condition'
  AND lower(concept_name) IN ('type 2 diabetes mellitus', 'diabetes mellitus type 2', 'type ii diabetes mellitus')
ORDER BY standard_concept DESC NULLS LAST, vocabulary_id, concept_name
LIMIT 20;

SELECT TOP 20 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id = 'Condition'
  AND LOWER(concept_name) IN ('type 2 diabetes mellitus', 'diabetes mellitus type 2', 'type ii diabetes mellitus')

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.condition_occurrence AS co
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor AS ca
  ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 201826;
